question: The cost price of 30 articles is the same as the selling price of x articles. If the profit is 25%, then the value of x is:
solution:
**Given:**

The cost price of 30 articles is the same as the selling price of x articles

Profit = 25%

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP – CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of the each article be Rs. 1

CP of x article = Rs. x

And, SP of each article = Rs. 30

Profit = SP – CP

⇒ (30 – x)

Now,

Profit% = [(30 – x)/x × 100] = 25

⇒ 3000 – 100x = 25x

⇒ 3000 = 25x + 100x

⇒ 3000 = 125x

⇒ x = (3000/125)

⇒ x = 24

**∴ The value of the x is 24**
